editorial: This report includes the trends that stood out today for the first time, without repeating what we have shared in recent days.

items.title: vitali87/code-graph-rag
items.summary: Code-graph-rag combines knowledge graphs and fetch-assisted generation (RAG) to understand and query complex structures in large code repositories. It allows developers to analyze and edit code bases in different languages ​​with the help of artificial intelligence.

items.title: google-deepmind/weathernext
items.summary: WeatherNext, developed by Google DeepMind, is a model that uses generative AI for weather forecasts. It aims to make faster and higher resolution atmospheric predictions compared to traditional physical simulations.

items.title: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
items.summary: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis is a stock market tracking system that analyzes multiple market data and current news using large language models. This Python-based tool offers a dashboard that supports investment decisions and allows you to schedule market monitoring for free with automatic notifications.

items.title: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
items.summary: ComfyUI is a modular visualization tool that provides a node-based interface for diffusion models. It allows users to design complex image processing processes with a visual flowchart and manage these processes via API.

items.title: harveyai/harvey-labs
items.summary: Harvey Labs is a benchmarking tool designed to measure and improve the capabilities of artificial intelligence agents that support tasks in the legal field. This study, prepared in Python language, aims to evaluate the performance of software that develops legal technologies with standard tests.

items.title: How I use LLMs to learn complex topics
items.summary: Large language models are used as personalized teachers in the process of learning complex subjects. Users are using AI-powered questioning methods to simplify concepts and identify learning gaps.

items.title: Windows 11's built-in Weather app wastes more than 1 GB of RAM
items.summary: The built-in weather application of the Windows 11 operating system uses system resources inefficiently by consuming more than 1 GB of memory (RAM) in the background. This shows that the application, which offers a simple interface, creates a higher than expected load on system performance.

items.title: Everything you do is being recorded
items.summary: The proliferation of artificial intelligence-supported wearable devices creates a surveillance environment where daily interactions are constantly recorded. This technological change necessitates the development of new defense mechanisms and personal data security strategies to protect the privacy of individuals.

items.title: Taxi drivers rarely die of Alzheimer's
items.summary: Taxi drivers' jobs, which require creating complex mental maps and spatial reasoning, reduce the risk of Alzheimer's disease. It is stated that keeping the brain constantly active provides protection against neurodegenerative processes by increasing cognitive reserve.

items.title: Cool URIs Don't Change (1998)
items.summary: This article published by W3C argues that web addresses (URI) should not change over time. He recommends creating permalink structures as a basic design principle to maintain content accessibility.

items.title: Can MLLMs Decode the Creative Leap? Introducing C4 for Cross-Concept Understanding
items.summary: The C4 framework, developed to measure the creative abilities of multimodal large language models, tests their cross-concept understanding capacity. This method embodies the creative problem-solving competence of artificial intelligence by evaluating the ability of models to establish non-obvious but meaningful relationships.

items.title: Do AI Personas Grow? Analyzing and Benchmarking Personality Evolution in LLM Agents After Life Events
items.summary: Personality-focused large language model agents (PC-Agents) are being developed to provide consistency in long-term interactions in areas such as emotional support and social simulation. This study offers an evaluation framework that analyzes how artificial intelligence agents change personality based on psychological foundations in response to life events.

items.title: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics as Rewards for Audio Reasoning
items.summary: A reinforcement learning method was developed that uses evolving evaluation criteria as a reward mechanism in audio reasoning processes. This approach allows the model to better focus on the audio data with a dynamic scoring system that adapts to the question rather than fixed rules.

items.title: PrivacyPeek: Auditing What LLM-Based Agents Acquire, Not Just What They Say
items.summary: PrivacyPeek is a method to monitor the tendency of large language model-based agents to include more sensitive data in their systems than they need to perform their tasks. This approach focuses on vulnerabilities in the data acquisition process, where data first enters the agent context, rather than the stage where data is exfiltrated.

items.title: Round-Trip Consistency: Bidirectional Diffusion Models Can Predict Their Own Rollout Errors
items.summary: Bidirectional diffusion models can measure their margin of error by moving forward and backward in time. This method allows detecting deviations in long-term forecasts with a self-supervised approach, without the need for a real data source.

items.title: Who Should Pay For Source Code Availability?
items.summary: In the software world, the accessibility of source code brings into question the balance between developer freedom and commercial sustainability. This debate focuses on the conflict between the financing models of open source projects and the property rights of software.

items.title: IRC technology news from the first half of 2026
items.summary: The Internet Relay Chat (IRC) protocol is coming to the fore again in the first half of 2026 with updates and new client software that comply with modern network standards. These improvements, especially focusing on encryption and connection stability, ensure that decentralized communication networks maintain their place in the current technology ecosystem.

items.title: Mea Culpa - Dark Hours
items.summary: The website Vibecoded copied the source code of an existing free software program without permission and presented it as its own product. This situation has brought the discussions of unethical code use and plagiarism to the agenda again in the software world.
